verdict.rationale: Lever documents in-product AI features that produce suggestions and insights from the customer's own hiring data. Talent Fit uses AI-powered matching to surface high-potential candidates, and AI Interview Transcripts and Summaries generate actionable recaps from interview conversations. Evidence is limited to one-line marketing claims, and the benchmarking 'insights' in analytics are not described as AI-generated. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how insights and suggestions are produced, AI-driven insights over analytics and dashboard data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Lever's Talent Fit uses AI-powered matching and customizable criteria to surface high-potential candidates quickly and easily.

AI Interview Transcripts and Summaries automatically capture conversations and generate actionable recaps, helping recruiters and hiring managers stay focused, speed up feedback, and make decisions faster.
